description: Lists the account's licence orders, newest first, each with its lines (publication, licence, unit, price, quantity, status). With order_id, returns one order, each line with its Schedule text and the SHA-256 fingerprint recorded in the public registry on Tempo when the line was issued. Read-only. Requires a buyer API key with the 'audit' scope, a buyer session, or the Opedd connector sign-in.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the prior response's pagination.next_cursor

order_id.description: Read one order (UUID) including Schedule documents

name: list_licence_orders
title: List your licence orders
